definitions.explanation: The permanent end of menstruation, generally occurring naturally in women between their late 40s and early 50s. Also used as a suru-verb ({閉経|へいけい}する) meaning 'to reach menopause'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{閉経|へいけい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My mother has already gone through menopause.

examples.japanese: {閉経|へいけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧だ。
examples.english: Menopause is a major change for women.

examples.japanese: {閉経|へいけい}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}く→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: After menopause, bones tend to become weaker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{閉経|へいけい}⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The average age of menopause in Japanese women is said to be around fifty.

notes:
Composed of {閉|へい} (close) and {経|けい} (here a shortening of {月経|げっけい}, menstruation). Medical term used in everyday speech as well; no coarser or more polite word is normally substituted.

USAGE:
- As a noun: {閉経|へいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to reach menopause).
- As a suru-verb: {閉経|へいけい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to undergo menopause), usually in the past tense: {閉経|へいけい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧.
- {閉経|へいけい}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ (post-menopausal) and {閉経|へいけい}⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (pre-menopausal) are common adjectival prefixes in medical and health contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閉経|へいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach menopause
- {閉経|へいけい}⟦{前後|ぜんご}→前後：04042_zengo⟧: around the time of menopause
- {閉経|へいけい}⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧: age of menopause
- ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧{閉経|へいけい}: early / premature menopause

RELATED WORDS:
- {月経|げっけい}: menstruation — the monthly process that ends at menopause
- {生理|せいり}: period (colloquial) — casual term for menstruation
- ⟦{更年期|こうねんき}→更年期：08710_kounenki⟧: menopausal period / climacteric — the years of transition surrounding menopause
